info.title: Dynamis Code Apps Template API
info.description: Stable v1 REST contract. Additive changes preserve authorization, ordering, errors, and side effects. Breaking changes require a new version or published migration window. Query collections use bounded filters, literal search, deterministic sorting, and opaque query-bound cursors. Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details. See docs/api.md for the human-readable reference.

post.description: Limited to 10 attempts per source address per minute by default.
Completes a password login with a time-based authenticator code.

204.description: Authenticator factor revoked and affected sessions revoked

post.description: Completes a password login with one single-use recovery code.
Completes a password login with a server-verified passkey assertion.

post.description: Owners and admins with resources:write create entries.
Add a fixed or manual price. Amount is a non-negative decimal string for fixed options and null or omitted for manual options.

get.description: Returns a deterministic page. Archived clients are excluded. Without sort, the page is newest first. Sort orders by one field, with empty values last and ties broken by client ID in the sort direction. Filters combine with AND. Total counts every client the filters and archived selector match. Clients have no free-text search in v1.

post.description: Creates a client. Members and above may write; viewers are refused.

get.description: Lists the workspace's custom fields. Archived fields are omitted unless includeArchived is true.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: Include archived fields. Defaults to false.

post.description: Defines a text custom field at the lowest free slot. Owners and admins only.
Hides a custom field from forms and keeps its values. Owners and admins only.
Restores an archived custom field. Owners and admins only.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an archived custom field. Its value is cleared from every client, its choice options are removed, and its slot is freed, all in one transaction. Active fields are refused with 409. Owners and admins only.

get.description: Choices of a single-choice field in slot order. Any role may read.

post.description: Adds a choice to a single-choice field. A field has at most 100 choices. Owners and admins only.

delete.description: Deletes a choice and clears it from every client that holds it, in one transaction. Owners and admins only.

get.description: Lists a page of manual entries in ascending date order. Requires client read permission. Continue until a page contains fewer entries than the limit.

post.description: Appends a manual entry. Requires client write permission. Corrections must reference an entry of this client.

get.description: Values for the workspace's active custom fields, in creation order. Any role may read.

put.description: Stores a text value under the field. Send the client ETag from the latest read in If-Match. Members and above.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong client ETag previously returned by this resource.

delete.description: Removes the value from the field. Send the client ETag from the latest read in If-Match. Members and above.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong client ETag previously returned by this resource.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. Send the ETag from the latest read in If-Match.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong client ETag previously returned by this resource.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a client and its custom values in one transaction. Owners and admins only.

post.description: Sets archivedAt. An archived client leaves the default list and shows with archived=archived or archived=all. Archiving an archived client changes nothing. Members and above only.
Clears archivedAt so the client returns to the default list. Unarchiving an active client changes nothing. Members and above only.

parameters.description: Opt in to pagination. Omit it and page to receive all members.

PageNumber.name: page
PageNumber.description: 1-based page number. Omit it for the first page; a page past the end is empty.

ClientSort.name: sort
ClientSort.description: Optional sort field: a common field (displayName, email, phone, notes, createdAt, updatedAt) or a custom field's short ID. A leading minus sorts descending. Number fields sort numerically. Text sorts by bytes. Empty values sort last.

ClientFilter.name: filter
ClientFilter.description: Optional condition as field:operator:value. May repeat; conditions combine with AND. A field may repeat in REST v1. is_empty takes an empty value and matches absent, null, or empty values. Common text fields (displayName, email, phone, notes) take equals or contains. Custom fields are named by short ID. Text takes equals or contains, case-insensitive for ASCII letters. Number and date take equals, before, after, or between (value from,to, inclusive). createdAt and updatedAt accept RFC3339 timestamp values with equals, before, after, or between. Before and after are strict. Yes/no takes equals with true or false. Single choice takes equals with one or more comma-separated option IDs. Equals on a number compares canonical decimal text, so 10.0 matches 10. Operators are documented in docs/api.md.

ClientArchived.name: archived
ClientArchived.description: Which clients the list shows. active (the default) excludes archived clients, archived shows only archived clients, and all shows both. Pages keep this value.

SCIMUserId.name: userId
SCIMUserId.description: SCIM resource id: the user's short ID. The IdP externalId, malformed, unknown, and foreign IDs return the same SCIM not-found error.

email.description: Optional. A bare email address when present.

archivedAt.description: Set while the client is archived. Null when active.

correctsId.description: Short ID of an entry belonging to this client.

email.description: Optional. A bare email address when present.
Optional. A bare email address when present.

value.description: Null when the field has no value. Otherwise the stored text: a decimal for number, YYYY-MM-DD for date, true or false for yes_no, and the option's short ID for single_choice.
Text value, or the short ID of a choice option of a single-choice field. Blank values are refused; use DELETE to clear.

customValues.description: Stored values keyed by client field short ID; unset fields are absent.

clientFields.description: Additive v1 key. Includes archived fields.

clientFieldOptions.description: Additive v1 key. Choice options of single-choice fields.

page.description: The page returned; present when pagination is requested.

id.description: Short user ID. The IdP externalId is returned separately.
